caption:
Life still a shaky tent, not a settled house? That's exactly what He promised to raise. (Amos 9:11 devotional)

God chose to raise a tent, not a fortress — He meets you in the unsettled, in-between place. Even if you feel you haven't settled yet.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Do I feel behind — still drifting while everyone else has settled?
